senses.gloss:
(इर्, उ) इर् भृशु r. 4th cl. (भृश्यति)
To fall, to fall down, literally or figuratively, as from a height, from dignity or virtue, &c.

mfn. (-शः-शा-शं)
Much, exceeding.
n. adv. (-शं)
Much, exceedingly.
ind. (भृशम्)
1 Much.
2 Eminently, superiorly, better.
3 Repeatedly.
4 Beautifully.
E.
भृश to fall, aff. क.

mfn. (-स्विद्)
Perspiring violently.
E.
भृश, and स्विद् to sweat, क्विन् aff.

mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं)
Fried.
E.
भ्रस्ज to fry, aff. क्त, the vowel substituted for the semivowel.

n. (-न्नं)
Rice boiled, and then fried.
E.
भृष्ट fried, अन्न boiled rice.

f. (-ष्टिः)
1 Frying.
2 An uninhabited or lonely garden, &c.
E.
भ्रस्ज to fry, aff. क्तिन्, the semivowel changed to ऋ.
